title: McPherson Governance v0.6 latency event set
description: Envelope for one canonical recorded or imported fixture latency stream. Each member of events is additionally validated against mcpherson-governance-latency-event/v1 by contract composition, imported members are subject to the same tag/value privacy policy as recorded events, all members must use one supported instrumentation version, and sequence identifiers must be ordered and contiguous from 1. This rejects duplicate or reordered sequence identifiers; because event files are unsigned local artifacts, it does not authenticate observation uniqueness or detect coherently renumbered payload copies. This contract accepts only FIXTURE; LIVE_SHADOW uses a distinct observer-owned contract.
